prefsRealFailed: Couldn't draw the picture. Try again.
prefsRealWraps: In the real picture the line wrapped, so subtitles would take more than two lines.
prefsWrapsWide: A {n}-letter line doesn't fit a wide video and would become a third line. Make the font smaller or allow fewer letters a line.
prefsWrapsTall: A tall video isn't wide enough for a {n}-letter line, so tarjim shortens its lines and the subtitles come out shorter.
prefsEnginesHint: Who translates, listens and dubs, your keys, and the tools.
tweaksHint: Not saved to your settings, used for this video only.
hint_look.style: A box behind the words, or outlined letters with no box.
hint_look.size_wide: A bigger font fits fewer letters a line.
hint_look.font: Only fonts on this computer that write this language.
hint_look.text_colour: Must stand out clearly on the box.
hint_look.box_opacity: At least 60% so nothing under the subtitle spoils it.
hint_look.position: Automatic: at the bottom, raised over text written in the video.
hint_look.speaker_colours: Each speaker's words in their own colour.
hint_look.mark: A small mark in a corner of the video.
hint_look.fade_ms: Zero: lines appear and leave at once.
hint_look.box_padding: A share of the font size.
hint_look.outline_width: A share of the font size.
hint_look.shadow: A soft shadow under the letters.
pref_look.bottom_margin_wide: Distance from the bottom, wide videos
hint_look.bottom_margin_wide: A share of the video's height.
pref_look.bottom_margin_tall: Distance from the bottom, tall videos
pref_look.top_margin_wide: Distance from the top, wide videos
hint_look.top_margin_wide: When the subtitle is at the top.
pref_look.top_margin_tall: Distance from the top, tall videos
hint_look.top_margin_tall: When the subtitle is at the top.
pref_look.speaker_palette: Colours of the second, third and fourth speaker
hint_look.speaker_palette: The first speaker uses the text colour.
pref_look.staged_reveal: The second speaker appears when they speak
hint_look.mark_size: A share of the video's short side.
hint_look.mark_side: Top or bottom is picked for you.
hint_look.dialogue_dash: Tells two speakers apart in a shared subtitle.
hint_text.reading_cps: Lower: shorter subtitles that can be read in time.
hint_text.line_chars: Lowered for you when the font cannot fit it.
pref_text.reading_warning: When to warn about fast lines
hint_text.reading_warning: A note in the report only, the subtitles stay the same.
hint_text.one_line: The short-video style. A dialogue keeps a line per speaker.
pref_timing.linger: Time left after the speaker stops
hint_timing.linger: Cut short by the next line or a scene change.
hint_timing.min_gap: Lets the eye see that the line changed.
pref_timing.long_pause: A pause this long starts a new line
hint_timing.long_pause: Must be longer than the joining pause.
pref_timing.join_gap: Longest pause short speech is joined across
hint_timing.join_gap: Short speech close together becomes one line.
pref_timing.min_readable: Speech shorter than this joins its neighbour
hint_timing.min_readable: Not below the shortest time on screen.
hint_timing.end_at_cuts: A line doesn't hang over into another shot.
hint_timing.cut_snap: A line close to a scene change snaps to it.
pref_timing.cut_dialogue_span: Quick dialogue across a scene change
pref_timing.dialogue_cues: Two speakers in one subtitle with dashes
hint_timing.dialogue_cues: Off: each speaker on their own.
hint_listen.passes: More: more accurate, slower and costlier.
pref_listen.gap_seconds: Shortest gap counted as missed speech
hint_listen.gap_seconds: Lower: looks harder for missed speech.
pref_listen.local_backup: If online listening fails, continue on this computer
hint_listen.local_backup: Off: the job stops and tells you why.
pref_listen.second_opinion: Check the timing with this computer's listening
hint_listen.second_opinion: Off is faster, but the timing is less exact.
pref_listen.voice_check: Check who is speaking by their voice
hint_listen.voice_check: Off is faster, but speakers are less exact.
hint_translate.numbers: Eastern digits are for Arabic only.
hint_translate.profanity: Softening or hiding keeps the meaning.
hint_translate.names: Your glossary always wins over this.
hint_translate.fillers: Kept only when the line has room.
pref_translate.local_backup: If translation fails, continue on this computer
hint_translate.local_backup: Off: the job stops and tells you why.
hint_output.folder: A folder on this computer, its full path.
pref_output.enlarge: Enlarge small videos before writing on them
hint_output.enlarge: Letters come out sharper on small videos.
pref_output.keep_ass: Keep the styled ASS subtitle file
hint_output.keep_ass: Keeps colours and places, for editing apps.
pref_output.burn_with_dub: Dubbed videos also get written subtitles
hint_output.burn_with_dub: Off: a dub with nothing written on it.
pref_dub.balance: Music and background under the dub
